sections.Profile:
"Jumpin' Jacks" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in October 1952. This upright game features a vertical playfield, distinguishing it from traditional horizontal pinball machines.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, Weird Pinball Machines
